<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion appears at m/z 127.10, which corresponds to a protonated molecule of neutral mass ≈126.10 Da. This matches the exact mass of C₈H₁₄O (126.104 Da). The isotope pattern (≈8 % M+1) is consistent with ~8 carbons. A simple structure fitting C₈H₁₄O and the degree of unsaturation (DBE = 2) is cyclooctanone, a cyclic ketone (one ring + one carbonyl). Its SMILES is “O=C1CCCCCCC1”. This SMILES is valid and matches the inferred formula.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C1CCCCCCC1</final_answer>
